highlights.title: Direct pairing for Dexcom G7, ONE+ and Stelo
changes: Trio can pair directly with Dexcom G7, ONE+ and Stelo sensors.
Trio will own lifecycle glucose alerts when a sensor is paired and can scan the applicator code.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1548: Add Dexcom G7, ONE+ and Stelo Direct Sensor Connection

highlights.title: Camera capture feedback and settings
changes: When you take a food photo, the scan frame flashes, the preview freezes, and a haptic tap plays.
New temporary Camera Feedback options under Settings > AI let you toggle and tune these effects.

includedPullRequests.title: Add Dexcom G7, ONE+ and Stelo Direct Sensor Connection
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

This PR introduces new connectivity method for Dexcom CGMs: It lets Trio connect straight to G7-family sensors over Bluetooth. No Dexcom app, no Dexcom account, no second phone relaying readings.

### What this gives users
  - Pairing with the 4-digit applicator code, typed or scanned from the Data Matrix on the applicator.
  - Full onboarding: site selection, insertion and overpatch guidance, then pairing.
  - Migration path: the existing read-through-the-Dexcom-app (i.e., passive consumption) mode stays for anyone mid-session without their code to hand. Settings shows when a direct connection is available and offers the switch, keeping the current session and its readings.
  - Session management: per-cycle reads, backfill of any gap, sensor model, serial, firmware, and 10- vs 15-day session length detected from the sensor itself.
  - Lifecycle alerts from Trio: expiring (24 h / 2 h), expired, session ended, sensor failed, signal loss, connection refused. All alerts get retracted when the sensor is replaced or the CGM removed.
  - Calibration with guidance on when it is and isn't appropriate, and a warning before sending a value far from the sensor's own.
  - Settings: lifecycle bar, last reading and trend, sensor details, previous-sensor record, and a device log of connections, commands and handshake steps.
  - Dexcom Share upload (opt-in): sign in under Settings > Dexcom Share to keep Dexcom Follow working without the Dexcom app, including follower management. Direct mode only; nothing is uploaded unless you sign in.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **CURRENT LIMITATIONS of Direct Connect**
> * does currently not allow for direct-to-watch for Dexcom G7
> * Dexcom Clarity is not covered; Share upload is opt-in and not yet validated on hardware

  ## Credit

This exists because of Erik Tolboom (@ETolboom) and Pete Schwamb (@ps2).

The direct G7 stack is Erik's work, built in `DexKit`, a hybrid project combining `G6SensorKit` work on direct G6/ONE integration with his own on G7, ONE+ and Stelo. `DexKit` ran in closed testing with a group of Trio users from early September, and the protocol was established the hard way: reverse-engineering sessions, BLE captures, and findings dug out of tester logs.

Later, `DexKit` development was halted. The decision was made to enhance `G7SensorKit` rather than adopt `DexKit` as a new, stand-alone CGM manager. Pete went through the effort of collecting the needed parts of the working implementation – i.e., the pairing planner and service, advertisement parsing, handshake sequencing in the authenticator, the BLE manager's active-peripheral and recovery handling, the applicator scanner, several message types, and the sensor application guide's steps and images – and refactored and extended the existing `G7SensorKit` so that we retain the passive pathway while adding this new, direct one. We are following this decision because we believe in a unified iOS OS-AID device infrastructure.

## For Testers

  - One display per sensor. A G7-family sensor admits one display at a time. The Dexcom app must be deleted (or disabled) before pairing. Please follow the onboarding instructions. Switching from the app to Trio needs the established connection ("sensor lease") to expire – force-quit or uninstall the official Dexcom app and wait ~15 minutes.
  - Alerts move to Trio. With direct pairing, the Dexcom app no longer alerts you. Onboarding checks notification permissions.
  - Dexcom Stelo is supported (DX01 advertisements, its own sensor model) but has had the least hardware validation. **We are actively looking for Stelo users to provide test feedback.**
  - Dexcom G6/ONE functionality is untouched by this PR. Where the G6 work from DexKit lands is undecided. Please retain using CGMBLEKit and the passive consumption mode.
  - Dexcom Share upload is new and opt-in. Nothing leaves the device unless you sign in with a Dexcom account (password stored in the keychain). Unvalidated on hardware.
  - Manual pairing was hardened for when other sensors are in range (G7SensorKit#70). Worth exercising if you keep spare sensors nearby.
  - Verified so far: builds clean, installs, launches, direct onboarding reachable from the existing picker entry. On-device pairing validation is what we need testers for.
